column7: UpdateProject (require_mfa change), CreateGlobalInvitation (system role and each project assignment) and rotation-policy Create checked their permission inline and answered a storage outage during the lookup as 403, the answer for a denial. They go through refuseUnlessAuthorized now: 503 + Retry-After for an outage, the handler's own 403 for a denial or an unrecognised error (fail closed). Their authorizeOutageExempt entries are deleted, so TestEveryRefusingPermissionCheckMapsAStorageOutage guards them.
